memorize.usageZh: 及物动词，后接名词或名词短语，表示通过反复练习达到精确记忆。常见搭配：memorize words/poems/dates。口语和书面语均可用，学习场景中高频出现。

examples.sentence: Mia memorizes five new words after dinner.
examples.trans: 米娅晚饭后熟记五个新单词。

examples.sentence: He memorizes the bus numbers so he will not get lost.
examples.trans: 他把公交车号背下来，免得迷路。

examples.sentence: Before the concert, she memorized every line of the song.
examples.trans: 音乐会前，她把歌词每一句都背熟了。

examples.sentence: Rather than memorizing isolated facts, he linked each date to a story.
examples.trans: 他没有孤立地背事实，而是把每个日期连到一个故事上。

examples.sentence: Athletes who memorize the route in daylight still hesitate in fog.
examples.trans: 白天把路线背下来的运动员，在雾里仍会犹豫。

examples.sentence: To memorize a speech is not the same as being able to answer unexpected questions.
examples.trans: 把演讲背下来，并不等于能应对突如其来的提问。

effective.usageZh: 形容词，表示“有效的、起作用的”，常用于修饰 method, way, measure, communication, treatment 等名词。注意与 efficient（高效的）区分：effective 强调“有效果”，efficient 强调“效率高”。

examples.sentence: Washing your hands often is an effective way to avoid getting sick.
examples.trans: 经常洗手是避免生病的一种有效方法。

examples.sentence: A clear timetable is more effective than last-minute panic.
examples.trans: 清晰的时间表比临时慌乱更有效。

examples.sentence: The new filter proved effective against the kitchen smoke.
examples.trans: 新过滤网对厨房油烟很有效。

examples.sentence: What looks effective on paper may fail when the team is tired.
examples.trans: 纸面上有效的方案，团队疲惫时可能失灵。

examples.sentence: An effective apology names the harm and offers a concrete repair.
examples.trans: 有效的道歉会点明伤害，并给出具体补救。

examples.sentence: Campaigns remain effective only while incentives and enforcement move together.
examples.trans: 只有激励与执行同步，宣传才会持续有效。

keen.usageZh: 形容词，表示热切、渴望。be keen on (doing) sth 热衷于；be keen to do 急切想做。也可修饰感官：keen eyesight 敏锐视力。比较级 keener。勿与 kind 混淆。

examples.sentence: Ben is keen on football after school.
examples.trans: 本放学后很爱踢足球。

examples.sentence: She is keen to help her little brother with maths.
examples.trans: 她很想帮弟弟做数学。

examples.sentence: Once he grew keen on cooking, the kitchen never stayed quiet.
examples.trans: 他迷上做饭后，厨房再也安静不下来。

examples.sentence: Investors remain keen on cities that protect old markets.
examples.trans: 投资者仍看好保护老市场的城市。

examples.sentence: A keen observer notices the pause before someone agrees.
examples.trans: 敏锐的观察者会注意到别人答应前的停顿。

examples.sentence: However keen the board is on expansion, cash flow still sets the limit.
examples.trans: 无论董事会多么热衷扩张，现金流仍划定上限。

encouragement.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“鼓励；激励”。常与 give、offer、provide、need 等动词搭配，也可说 words of encouragement（鼓励的话）。多用于谈论教育、成长、团队合作等场景。

examples.sentence: Dad's smile was enough encouragement for me.
examples.trans: 爸爸的微笑对我来说就是鼓励。

examples.sentence: A little encouragement helped her finish the long jump.
examples.trans: 一点点鼓励帮她完成了跳远。

examples.sentence: The coach's encouragement kept the tired runners moving.
examples.trans: 教练的鼓励让疲惫的跑者继续向前。

examples.sentence: Public encouragement means little if private feedback is cruel.
examples.trans: 私下反馈很刻薄时，公开的鼓励意义不大。

examples.sentence: She wrote notes of encouragement on the inside of every lunch box.
examples.trans: 她在每个午餐盒内侧都写了鼓励的话。

examples.sentence: Encouragement that ignores real obstacles can sound like pressure in a softer voice.
examples.trans: 忽视真实困难的鼓励，听起来像更轻声的施压。

confidence.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“信心；自信”。常见搭配：have confidence in sb./sth.（对……有信心）、build up/gain confidence（建立/获得信心）、lose confidence（失去信心）、with confidence（自信地）。

examples.sentence: I spoke with confidence after I practised twice.
examples.trans: 练了两遍后，我说话有信心了。

examples.sentence: Her confidence grew when the first pancake came out round.
examples.trans: 第一张饼摊圆了，她的信心就长起来了。

examples.sentence: He lost confidence for a week after missing the open goal.
examples.trans: 空门没踢进后，他有一周都没了信心。

examples.sentence: Having confidence in your own judgment is essential when making important decisions.
examples.trans: 在做重要决定时，相信自己的判断是至关重要的。

examples.sentence: It was not talent but quiet confidence that carried her through the interview.
examples.trans: 让她通过面试的不是天赋，而是沉稳的自信。

examples.sentence: Markets treat sudden confidence as a signal, whether or not the data can carry it.
examples.trans: 市场把突然出现的信心当作信号，不管数据是否撑得住。

translation.usageZh: 可作不可数名词（指翻译行为或过程）或可数名词（指具体的译文）。常见搭配：the translation of sth.、translation version、do translation、literal translation（直译）、free translation（意译）。

examples.sentence: This translation of the joke is still funny.
examples.trans: 这个笑话的译文仍然好笑。

examples.sentence: She did a careful translation of the recipe from Italian.
examples.trans: 她把意大利食谱仔细译成了中文。

examples.sentence: A word-for-word translation missed the warmth of the original letter.
examples.trans: 逐字翻译丢掉了原信里的温度。

examples.sentence: Good translation carries tone, not only dictionary meaning.
examples.trans: 好的翻译带走语气，而不只是词典义。

examples.sentence: The museum printed a translation beside every faded inscription.
examples.trans: 博物馆在每段褪色铭文旁都印了译文。

examples.sentence: What resists translation often reveals where two cultures draw different lines.
examples.trans: 难以翻译之处，往往暴露两种文化划界的不同。

patient.usageZh: 形容词：有耐心的，be/stay/remain patient with sb。也可作可数名词：病人 a patient。副词 patiently。名词 patience 为不可数。

examples.sentence: My grandpa is very patient when he teaches me to fish.
examples.trans: 爷爷教我钓鱼的时候非常有耐心。

examples.sentence: Please be patient with the new puppy; he is still learning.
examples.trans: 请对新小狗有耐心，它还在学。

examples.sentence: The nurse stayed patient even when the queue grew long.
examples.trans: 队伍变长时，护士依然保持耐心。

examples.sentence: A patient editor waits for the right verb instead of forcing a loud one.
examples.trans: 有耐心的编辑会等那个恰当的动词，而不是硬塞一个响亮的。

examples.sentence: Being patient with a stalled project is not the same as ignoring its delays.
examples.trans: 对停滞的项目有耐心，并不等于无视它的拖延。

examples.sentence: The clinic's newest patient asked quietly whether the wait would last another hour.
examples.trans: 诊所里最新来的病人轻声问，还要再等一个小时吗。

partner.usageZh: 可数名词，指一起做某事的人。常用搭配：language partner（语伴）、business partner（商业伙伴）、dance partner（舞伴）、partner in crime（口语中可指“一起捣蛋的同伴”）。

examples.sentence: My partner in the game passes the ball to me.
examples.trans: 游戏里的搭档把球传给我。

examples.sentence: She found a language partner to practise French on Sundays.
examples.trans: 她找了个语伴，周日练习法语。

examples.sentence: The two partners shared the cost of the small bakery.
examples.trans: 两个合伙人分摊了小面包店的费用。

examples.sentence: A research partner who challenges your data is more useful than one who only nods.
examples.trans: 会质疑你数据的研究搭档，比只会点头的更有用。

examples.sentence: The museum partnered with local guides to open evening tours.
examples.trans: 博物馆与本地向导合作，开通了夜间游览。

examples.sentence: When a partnership rests only on profit, trust tends to thin out first.
examples.trans: 合伙若只靠利润维系，信任往往最先变薄。

stick.usageZh: 动词，意为“坚持；粘住”。常用短语：stick to sth（坚持某事，如计划、决定、原则）、stick with it（坚持下去）、stick together（粘在一起；团结一致）。也可作名词，意为“棍子；枝条”。

examples.sentence: The stamp won't stick to the envelope because it is wet.
examples.trans: 邮票粘不到信封上，因为它是湿的。

examples.sentence: If you stick to your piano practice, the song will come.
examples.trans: 如果你坚持练琴，这首歌就会出来。

examples.sentence: She decided to stick to her original answer even though most of the class disagreed with her.
examples.trans: 尽管班上大多数同学不同意，她还是决定坚持自己原来的答案。

examples.sentence: Teams that stick to a messy process rarely notice better tools.
examples.trans: 死守混乱流程的团队，很少注意到更好的工具。

examples.sentence: While adapting to new circumstances is important, great leaders know when to stick to their core principles without compromise.
examples.trans: 虽然适应新环境很重要，但优秀的领导者知道何时该毫不妥协地坚守自己的核心原则。

examples.sentence: To stick to a principle is harder when the cheaper option is sitting in the same room.
examples.trans: 更便宜的选项就在同一间屋里时，坚持原则更难。

communicate.usageZh: 通常作不及物动词，与 with 连用表示“与……交流”，如 communicate with others；也可作及物动词，后接 ideas、feelings 等。名词形式为 communication。

examples.sentence: We communicate with Grandma on the phone every Sunday.
examples.trans: 我们每周日打电话和奶奶交流。

examples.sentence: The two teams communicate with hand signals in the noisy hall.
examples.trans: 嘈杂的大厅里，两队用手势交流。

examples.sentence: She communicated the change of plan in a short note.
examples.trans: 她用一张短纸条传达了计划的改动。

examples.sentence: Leaders who communicate late force others to invent the missing facts.
examples.trans: 沟通太晚的负责人，会逼别人去编造缺失的事实。

examples.sentence: The app helps hikers communicate even when the mountain road has no signal towers nearby.
examples.trans: 即使山路附近没有信号塔，这款应用也能帮徒步者联络。

examples.sentence: To communicate across disciplines is to translate assumptions, not only terms.
examples.trans: 跨学科交流要翻译的是前提，而不只是术语。

familiar.usageZh: 形容词。常用搭配：be/become familiar with sth.（熟悉某事物），sth. is familiar to sb.（某物对某人来说很熟悉）。注意两个搭配中介词和主语位置不同。

examples.sentence: This street is familiar because my aunt lives here.
examples.trans: 这条街很熟，因为阿姨住在这儿。

examples.sentence: Before the trip, the guide helped us become familiar with the local customs.
examples.trans: 旅行前，导游帮助我们熟悉了当地的风俗习惯。

examples.sentence: The melody grew familiar after she heard it three times.
examples.trans: 听了三遍后，这段旋律就熟悉了。

examples.sentence: A familiar argument can still be wrong; comfort is not evidence.
examples.trans: 熟悉的论点仍可能是错的；舒服不是证据。

examples.sentence: She familiarized herself with the tide tables before launching the boat.
examples.trans: 开船前，她先熟悉了潮汐表。

examples.sentence: What feels familiar in a new city is often a copy of home, not the city itself.
examples.trans: 在陌生城市里感到熟悉的，往往是家乡的复制，而不是这座城本身。

properly.usageZh: 副词，由形容词 proper 派生而来。修饰动词，表示“以正确或合适的方式”。常用搭配：do sth. properly, work/function properly, be properly trained/dressed。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands properly before lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭前把手洗干净。

examples.sentence: The lamp will not work properly if the plug is loose.
examples.trans: 插头松了，灯就不能正常工作。

examples.sentence: She packed the glasses properly so none broke on the train.
examples.trans: 她把杯子包好，火车上一个也没碎。

examples.sentence: A tool used improperly can injure faster than it can help.
examples.trans: 工具用得不对，伤人比帮人更快。

examples.sentence: The contract was properly dated, stamped, and filed before noon.
examples.trans: 合同在中午前就正确标注日期、盖章并归档了。

examples.sentence: Until the sensors are calibrated properly, the dashboard will keep telling elegant lies.
examples.trans: 传感器没校准好之前，仪表盘会一直说出精致的谎话。

intermediate.usageZh: 形容词。常用来描述语言学习者的水平或课程的难度，表示“中级的”。也可表示空间或时间上的“中间的”。常见搭配：intermediate level, intermediate course, intermediate stage。

examples.sentence: This book is for intermediate readers, not beginners.
examples.trans: 这本书给中级读者，不是给初学者。

examples.sentence: After one year she moved from beginner to intermediate class.
examples.trans: 一年后她从初级班升到中级班。

examples.sentence: The trail has an intermediate section with loose stones.
examples.trans: 这条小路有一段中等难度、石头松动的路。

examples.sentence: Intermediate learners often understand more than they dare to say.
examples.trans: 中级学习者常常听得懂的比敢说的多。

examples.sentence: The lab hired an intermediate technician who could already calibrate the meter.
examples.trans: 实验室雇了一名已会校准仪表的中级技术员。

examples.sentence: An intermediate stage of reform can look messy while old rules and new ones overlap.
examples.trans: 改革的中间阶段可能显得乱，因为新旧规则叠在一起。

advanced.usageZh: 形容词。描述水平、技术、思想等，表示“高级的；先进的”。常用搭配：advanced learner, advanced course, advanced technology, advanced stage。注意与“advance”（动词/名词）区分。

examples.sentence: My brother is good at math, so he takes an advanced class.
examples.trans: 我哥哥数学很好，所以他上了一个高级班。

examples.sentence: His advanced camera takes clear pictures at night.
examples.trans: 他的高级相机夜里也能拍清楚。

examples.sentence: The hospital uses advanced equipment to detect heart problems at an early stage.
examples.trans: 这家医院使用先进设备在早期阶段检测心脏问题。

examples.sentence: Advanced tools do not replace the need to ask a better question.
examples.trans: 先进工具替代不了提出更好问题的需要。

examples.sentence: The hospital installed an advanced scanner that shortened waiting times.
examples.trans: 医院装了先进扫描仪，缩短了等候时间。

examples.sentence: What counts as advanced in one decade becomes ordinary in the next.
examples.trans: 十年前算先进的东西，下一个十年就变平常了。

inaccurate.usageZh: 形容词。表示“不准确的；不精确的”，反义词是 accurate。常修饰 information, report, measurement, description 等名词。注意前缀 in- 表示否定。

examples.sentence: The map is inaccurate, so we got lost on the way to the park.
examples.trans: 这张地图不准确，所以我们在去公园的路上迷路了。

examples.sentence: The article contained several inaccurate facts about the history of the town.
examples.trans: 这篇文章里有几处关于该镇历史的不准确事实。

examples.sentence: His inaccurate summary left out the key safety rule.
examples.trans: 他不准确的摘要漏掉了关键安全规则。

examples.sentence: Inaccurate captions on photos can spread faster than corrections.
examples.trans: 照片上不准确的说明，传播得比更正更快。

examples.sentence: The report was not lying, but several figures were inaccurate by a wide margin.
examples.trans: 报告并非撒谎，但有几个数字偏差很大。

examples.sentence: An inaccurate model of demand will quietly bankrupt a careful plan.
examples.trans: 对需求的不准确模型，会悄悄毁掉一份谨慎的计划。

experience.usageZh: 可作不可数名词（经验）或可数名词（经历）。常用搭配：learning experience（学习经历）、work experience（工作经验）、have experience in（在……方面有经验）。作动词时表示“经历；体验”。

examples.sentence: Camping in the rain was a new experience for me.
examples.trans: 雨中露营对我来说是新经历。

examples.sentence: She has a lot of experience in teaching young children.
examples.trans: 她在教小孩子方面有很多经验。

examples.sentence: They experienced a sudden blackout during the film.
examples.trans: 看电影时他们经历了突然停电。

examples.sentence: Having worked abroad for three years, he brings valuable experience to the team.
examples.trans: 由于在国外工作过三年，他为团队带来了宝贵的经验。

examples.sentence: An experienced guide changed the route when the river rose.
examples.trans: 河水上涨时，有经验的向导改了路线。

examples.sentence: What we call experience is often a pattern we noticed just in time.
examples.trans: 我们所谓的经验，常常只是及时察觉到的一种模式。

pronunciation.usageZh: 不可数名词，动词是 pronounce。常用搭配：practice/improve one's pronunciation（练习/改善发音）、clear pronunciation（清晰的发音）、correct pronunciation（正确的发音）。

examples.sentence: Her pronunciation of 'three' is very clear.
examples.trans: 她发 three 这个音很清楚。

examples.sentence: He checks the pronunciation of new names before calling them.
examples.trans: 叫新名字前，他先核对其发音。

examples.sentence: A small change in pronunciation made the joke land.
examples.trans: 发音上的一点变化让笑话奏效了。

examples.sentence: Pronunciation marks attitude as much as it marks sound.
examples.trans: 发音既标声音，也标态度。

examples.sentence: Although her grammar was not perfect, her clear pronunciation made her easy to understand.
examples.trans: 尽管她的语法并不完美，但她清晰的发音让人很容易听懂。

examples.sentence: Learners chase a native pronunciation that even natives do not share.
examples.trans: 学习者追一种连母语者都不共享的“标准发音”。

phrase.usageZh: 可数名词。常用搭配：a set phrase（固定短语）、learn useful phrases（学习有用的短语）、a noun phrase（名词短语）。也可作动词，表示“措辞；表达”。

examples.sentence: 'Good morning' is a short phrase we use every day.
examples.trans: “早上好”是我们每天用的短短语。

examples.sentence: Write down any useful phrase you hear in the song.
examples.trans: 把歌里听到的有用短语记下来。

examples.sentence: The coach phrased the advice more kindly the second time.
examples.trans: 教练第二次把建议说得更温和。

examples.sentence: The phrase "in the long run" is often used when discussing the future consequences of present actions.
examples.trans: 短语“in the long run”常用于讨论当前行为对未来的影响。

examples.sentence: She crossed out the legal phrase and wrote a sentence a neighbour could follow.
examples.trans: 她划掉法律套话，写成邻居也能看懂的句子。

examples.sentence: How a demand is phrased often decides whether it is heard as a request or a threat.
examples.trans: 要求的措辞，常常决定它被听成请求还是威胁。

support.usageZh: 可作动词或不可数名词。作动词时表示“支持、支撑、养活”，作名词时常与 give/offer/provide 搭配，也可指“情感支持”或“经济支持”。口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: My parents always support me when I play football.
examples.trans: 我踢足球时，父母总是支持我。

examples.sentence: The school offered extra support to students who found maths difficult.
examples.trans: 学校为觉得数学难的学生提供了额外帮助。

examples.sentence: Neighbours showed support by bringing hot soup after the flood.
examples.trans: 洪水后邻居送来热汤表示支持。

examples.sentence: Support that arrives without listening can feel like another task.
examples.trans: 不先倾听就给出的支持，可能像又一项任务。

examples.sentence: The bridge was supported by two new beams after the inspection.
examples.trans: 检查后，桥被两根新梁撑住了。

examples.sentence: Public support for the park faded when evening lights stayed broken for months.
examples.trans: 夜灯坏了几个月，公众对公园的支持便淡了。

essential.usageZh: 形容词，表示“绝对必要的、极其重要的”，常与 for 或 to 连用，如 be essential for/to sth。也可作名词，表示“必需品、要素”，常用复数形式 essentials。

examples.sentence: Water is essential on a long walk.
examples.trans: 长途步行时水是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: It is essential to wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
examples.trans: 骑自行车时戴头盔是非常必要的。

examples.sentence: Sleep is essential to a clear head the next morning.
examples.trans: 睡眠对第二天头脑清醒必不可少。

examples.sentence: Trust is essential to any team that shares unfinished work.
examples.trans: 对分享未完成工作的团队来说，信任是必要的。

examples.sentence: The kit lists only essential tools so the bag stays light.
examples.trans: 工具包只列必需工具，包才能保持轻便。

examples.sentence: What is essential in a crisis is often invisible in ordinary weeks.
examples.trans: 危机中必不可少的东西，在平常的几周里往往看不见。

perception.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“看法、感知”。常与动词 limit、change、influence、shape 搭配，如 change one's perception of something。也可用于感官感知，如 visual perception。语体偏正式，适合书面和学术表达。

examples.sentence: His perception of the city changed after one night market.
examples.trans: 逛过一次夜市后，他对这座城的看法变了。

examples.sentence: From the back row, her perception of the stage was incomplete.
examples.trans: 坐在后排，她对舞台的感知是不完整的。

examples.sentence: Loud colours can change a child's perception of a quiet room.
examples.trans: 鲜艳颜色会改变孩子对安静房间的感觉。

examples.sentence: Public perception often lags behind the data by several years.
examples.trans: 公众看法常常落后数据好几年。

examples.sentence: What struck me most was the gap between public perception and the reality of the situation.
examples.trans: 最让我震惊的是公众的看法与实际情况之间的差距。

examples.sentence: Perception is not a photograph; it is a story the brain finishes in a hurry.
examples.trans: 感知不是照片，而是大脑匆忙补完的故事。

master.usageZh: 及物动词，表示“掌握、精通”，后接语言、技能、乐器等名词，如 master a language、master a skill。也可作名词，表示“大师、主人”。作动词时语体较正式，强调达到高水平。

examples.sentence: It took me a long time to master riding a bike without help.
examples.trans: 我花了很长时间才学会不用人扶骑自行车。

examples.sentence: He mastered the lock after watching Grandpa twice.
examples.trans: 看爷爷开了两次锁，他就学会了。

examples.sentence: It took a year to master the quiet stroke in the pool.
examples.trans: 花了一年才掌握泳池里安静的划水。

examples.sentence: To master a craft is to notice mistakes that beginners cannot yet see.
examples.trans: 精通一门手艺，就是看见初学者还看不见的错误。

examples.sentence: The young chef has not mastered heat control, though her seasoning is brave.
examples.trans: 年轻厨师还没掌握火候，尽管调味很大胆。

examples.sentence: Mastery without curiosity turns into repetition dressed as excellence.
examples.trans: 没有好奇心的精通，会变成伪装成卓越的重复。

access.usageZh: 不可数名词，常与介词 to 连用，表示“使用权、进入权”，如 have access to information、easy access to education。也可作及物动词，表示“访问（计算机文件或数据）”。语体中性，日常和正式场合均可用。

examples.sentence: The library gives students free access to computers after school.
examples.trans: 图书馆让学生在放学后免费使用电脑。

examples.sentence: We could not access the upstairs room without the key.
examples.trans: 没有钥匙，我们进不了楼上的房间。

examples.sentence: Wheelchair access was added beside the old stone steps.
examples.trans: 旧石阶旁加了轮椅通道。

examples.sentence: Access to clean water still decides where a village can grow.
examples.trans: 能否用上干净的水，仍决定村庄能在哪里发展。

examples.sentence: Researchers accessed the archive only after signing a quiet agreement.
examples.trans: 研究者签下一份低调协议后，才得以查阅档案。

examples.sentence: When access is sold as a privilege, knowledge starts to look like a gated park.
examples.trans: 当使用权被当成特权出售，知识看起来就像一座上锁的公园。

inconvenience.usageZh: 通常作不可数名词，表示“不便、麻烦”，常与 cause, avoid, apologize for 等动词搭配。也可作及物动词，意为“给……带来不便”，用于较正式的语境。

examples.sentence: The broken lift caused a lot of inconvenience for old people.
examples.trans: 坏了的电梯给老人们带来了很多不便。

examples.sentence: Sorry for the inconvenience; the road is being repaired.
examples.trans: 造成不便很抱歉，这条路正在修。

examples.sentence: A delayed ferry inconvenienced families waiting with cold food.
examples.trans: 轮渡延误，让带着冷食等候的家庭很麻烦。

examples.sentence: What looks like a small inconvenience can undo a tightly timed plan.
examples.trans: 看似小小的不便，也能打乱排得很紧的计划。

examples.sentence: The temporary closure of the footbridge may inconvenience local residents, but the repair work is necessary.
examples.trans: 人行天桥的临时关闭可能会给当地居民带来不便，但维修工作是必要的。

examples.sentence: Cities often hide inconvenience behind those who cannot reschedule their lives.
examples.trans: 城市常常把不便藏到那些无法改期生活的人身上。

resources.usageZh: 通常以复数形式出现，表示“资源”，可指自然资源、人力资源、学习资源等。常与 natural, educational, online, limited, rich 等形容词搭配。

examples.sentence: The classroom has many picture-book resources.
examples.trans: 教室里有许多图画书资源。

examples.sentence: We used online resources to check the train times.
examples.trans: 我们用网上资源核对火车时刻。

examples.sentence: The small farm stretched its water resources through a dry August.
examples.trans: 小农场靠有限的水资源撑过了干燥的八月。

examples.sentence: Human resources are not a pool you can drain without consequence.
examples.trans: 人力资源不是可以抽干而不付出代价的池子。

examples.sentence: Unlike large cities, many rural schools still lack the basic resources needed for modern science education.
examples.trans: 与大城市不同，许多农村学校仍然缺乏现代科学教育所需的基本资源。

examples.sentence: When public resources shrink, private luck starts to look like talent.
examples.trans: 公共资源缩水时，私人运气开始看起来像才能。

widespread.usageZh: 形容词，意为“广泛的；普遍的”。常作定语修饰名词，如 widespread use/acceptance/concern；也可作表语，如 be/become widespread。语体偏正式，适用于书面和口语中描述现象、问题或态度。

examples.sentence: The game is widespread among children in our school.
examples.trans: 这个游戏在我们学校的孩子们中很流行。

examples.sentence: The flu became widespread in the valley last winter.
examples.trans: 去年冬天流感在山谷里蔓延得很广。

examples.sentence: There is widespread support for keeping the night market open.
examples.trans: 普遍支持夜市继续开放。

examples.sentence: Widespread rumour outran the official statement by several hours.
examples.trans: 广泛流传的谣言比官方声明早了好几个小时。

examples.sentence: Damage was widespread along the coast, though the harbour wall held.
examples.trans: 沿岸破坏很广，但港墙守住了。

examples.sentence: A widespread technology can still leave the people who built it unpaid.
examples.trans: 一项普及的技术，仍可能让建造它的人拿不到报酬。

ignored.usageZh: 动词 ignore 的过去分词，常作表语或定语，表示“被忽视的”。常见搭配：be ignored, cannot be ignored, feel ignored。语体中性，口语和书面语均常用。

examples.sentence: My little brother felt ignored when we talked about the trip.
examples.trans: 当我们谈论旅行时，我弟弟觉得自己被冷落了。

examples.sentence: The warning signs were ignored by many drivers on the road.
examples.trans: 路上的许多司机忽视了那些警示标志。

examples.sentence: Safety rules cannot be ignored just because the hill looks easy.
examples.trans: 不能因为山看起来好走就无视安全规则。

examples.sentence: Emails that are ignored still exist; silence is also an answer.
examples.trans: 被忽略的邮件依然存在；沉默也是一种回答。

examples.sentence: The committee ignored the quieter villages when it drew the new bus map.
examples.trans: 委员会画新公交图时忽略了更安静的村子。

examples.sentence: What is ignored in a budget will return as an emergency, usually at night.
examples.trans: 预算里被忽略的东西，往往会作为紧急事件回来，而且通常在夜里。

continuous.usageZh: 形容词，意为“连续的；不间断的”。常修饰名词，如 continuous rain/progress/flow/contact。注意与 continual（频繁的、反复的）区分：continuous 强调无间断，continual 强调反复发生。

examples.sentence: There was continuous rain from breakfast to lunch.
examples.trans: 从早饭到午饭一直在下雨。

examples.sentence: The radio played continuous music during the power cut.
examples.trans: 停电时收音机连续放着音乐。

examples.sentence: Continuous practice made her handwriting smaller and clearer.
examples.trans: 持续练习让她的字更小更清楚。

examples.sentence: Continuous noise in the workshop made short meetings necessary.
examples.trans: 车间里持续的噪声让短会变得必要。

examples.sentence: They kept continuous contact with the boat by radio until midnight.
examples.trans: 他们用无线电与船保持连续联系直到午夜。

examples.sentence: Continuous growth is a story companies tell; nature prefers cycles.
examples.trans: 持续增长是公司讲的故事；自然更喜欢循环。

improve.usageZh: 及物或不及物动词。常与'skills'、'yourself'、'relationship'、'health'等名词搭配。与'on'连用表示'做出比之前更好的东西'。口语和书面语都常用，是PET高频词。

examples.sentence: I want to improve my handwriting this term.
examples.trans: 这学期我想把字写好一些。

examples.sentence: The soup improved after she added a little salt.
examples.trans: 她加了点盐，汤就更好喝了。

examples.sentence: They improved the path so bikes could pass safely.
examples.trans: 他们把小路修好，自行车可以安全通过。

examples.sentence: To improve a system you must first admit where it fails quietly.
examples.trans: 要改进一套系统，得先承认它在哪些地方悄悄失灵。

examples.sentence: An improved timetable cut the wait at the ferry by twenty minutes.
examples.trans: 改进后的时刻表把轮渡等候缩短了二十分钟。

examples.sentence: Improvement that cannot be felt by the people who do the work is mostly a slide in a meeting.
examples.trans: 做这项工作的人感觉不到的改进，多半只是会上的一张幻灯片。

attitude.usageZh: 可数名词。常与'positive'、'negative'、'relaxed'、'change'等词搭配。与'towards'连用表示'对……的态度'。可用于描述人的行为表现或心理状态，口语和书面语均常见。

examples.sentence: Her kind attitude made the new boy less nervous.
examples.trans: 她友善的态度让新来的男孩不那么紧张。

examples.sentence: A careless attitude towards fire is dangerous in dry grass.
examples.trans: 在干草地上对火漫不经心很危险。

examples.sentence: His attitude towards mistakes is simple: fix them and continue.
examples.trans: 他对错误的态度很简单：改掉，继续。

examples.sentence: Attitude is visible in how someone treats the person who cannot help them.
examples.trans: 态度显现在一个人如何对待帮不了自己的人。

examples.sentence: Public attitudes towards night buses shifted after two safe winters.
examples.trans: 两个安全的冬天过后，公众对夜班车的态度变了。

examples.sentence: An attitude dressed as realism can be an excuse for leaving the hard part untouched.
examples.trans: 打扮成现实主义的态度，可能是不去碰困难部分的借口。

contact.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“联系；接触”。常见搭配：make contact with（与……取得联系）、keep in contact（保持联系）、lose contact（失去联系）、eye contact（眼神交流）。也可作动词，表示“联系某人”。

examples.sentence: My mom keeps in contact with her old classmates on WeChat.
examples.trans: 我妈妈在微信上和她的老同学保持联系。

examples.sentence: She lost contact with her old neighbour after the move.
examples.trans: 搬家后她和老邻居失去了联系。

examples.sentence: The school contacted parents about the early finish.
examples.trans: 学校就提前放学联系了家长。

examples.sentence: First contact with a new team tells you how they handle a small mistake.
examples.trans: 与新团队的第一次接触，能看出他们如何处理小错误。

examples.sentence: A contactless card let him pay when he had forgotten cash.
examples.trans: 忘带现金时，非接触卡让他付了款。

examples.sentence: In a dense city, contact is constant; solitude has to be arranged.
examples.trans: 在密集城市里，接触是持续的；独处反而需要安排。

progress.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“进步；进展”。常见搭配：make progress（取得进步）、make great/little progress（进步很大/很小）、in progress（进行中）。作动词时读作 /prəˈɡres/，表示“进展；前进”。

examples.sentence: My little brother is making progress in learning to swim.
examples.trans: 我弟弟在学游泳方面正在进步。

examples.sentence: The builders made slow progress in the heavy rain.
examples.trans: 大雨里工人进展很慢。

examples.sentence: If we stop asking questions, progress will stand still.
examples.trans: 如果我们不再提问，进步就会停住。

examples.sentence: Progress that ignores who is left behind is only speed.
examples.trans: 忽视被落下者的进步，只是速度。

examples.sentence: The talks progressed after both sides put the maps on one table.
examples.trans: 双方把地图放到同一张桌上后，谈判有了进展。

examples.sentence: What we celebrate as progress may be a cost shifted onto another decade.
examples.trans: 我们当作进步来庆祝的，可能是转嫁到下一个十年的成本。

ability.usageZh: 可数或不可数名词，表示“能力”。常见搭配：have the ability to do sth（有做某事的能力）、develop/improve one's ability（培养/提高某人的能力）、to the best of one's ability（尽某人最大努力）。

examples.sentence: Birds have the ability to fly long distances without stopping.
examples.trans: 鸟类有能力不停歇地长距离飞行。

examples.sentence: Playing chess helps children develop the ability to think ahead.
examples.trans: 下棋帮助孩子们培养提前思考的能力。

examples.sentence: Practice improved her ability to read maps in poor light.
examples.trans: 练习提高了她在弱光下读地图的能力。

examples.sentence: Ability without opportunity still looks like absence of talent.
examples.trans: 没有机会的能力，看起来仍像没有才华。

examples.sentence: Unlike raw talent, the ability to collaborate effectively with others is a skill that can be learned and refined over time.
examples.trans: 与天赋不同，与他人有效合作的能力是一种可以随着时间学习和打磨的技能。

examples.sentence: An ability measured only by tests will miss the work that happens off the page.
examples.trans: 只靠考试衡量的能力，会漏掉纸页之外发生的工作。

afford.usageZh: 及物动词，后接名词或不定式。常与 can, could, be able to 连用，多用于否定句或疑问句，表示“负担得起”或“承担得起”。

examples.sentence: We cannot afford a taxi tonight, so we will walk.
examples.trans: 今晚打不起车，我们走路。

examples.sentence: Can you afford to buy both tickets and still eat lunch?
examples.trans: 你买得起两张票还吃得起午饭吗？

examples.sentence: They could not afford to miss another practice before the match.
examples.trans: 比赛前他们再错过一次训练就亏不起了。

examples.sentence: A city that cannot afford parks will pay later in crowded rooms.
examples.trans: 建不起公园的城市，日后会在拥挤的房间里还债。

examples.sentence: She afforded herself one slow morning after the long audit.
examples.trans: 漫长审计之后，她允许自己过一个慢早晨。

examples.sentence: What we cannot afford is not always money; sometimes it is another delay.
examples.trans: 我们负担不起的，不一定是钱；有时是再一次拖延。

advantages.usageZh: 可数名词，通常用复数形式。常与 have, offer, provide 等动词搭配，与 over 连用表示“比……有优势”。

examples.sentence: One of the advantages of this phone is its long battery life.
examples.trans: 这部手机的一个优点是电池续航时间长。

examples.sentence: Living near the sea has many advantages, such as fresh air and beautiful views.
examples.trans: 住在海边有很多好处，比如空气新鲜、风景优美。

examples.sentence: Although online learning has some disadvantages, its advantages often make it a popular choice.
examples.trans: 虽然在线学习有一些缺点，但它的优点往往使其成为热门选择。

examples.sentence: One of the main advantages of studying abroad is the chance to experience a different culture firsthand.
examples.trans: 出国留学的主要优势之一是有机会亲身体验不同的文化。

examples.sentence: Compared with traditional advertising, social media marketing offers clear advantages in terms of cost and reach.
examples.trans: 与传统广告相比，社交媒体营销在成本和覆盖面方面具有明显优势。

examples.sentence: Apparent advantages can hide costs that arrive after the contract is signed.
examples.trans: 表面上的优势可能藏着签约之后才到来的代价。

affordable.usageZh: 形容词，用于描述商品、服务、价格等，表示“负担得起的；价格合理的”。常与 housing, price, option 等名词搭配。

examples.sentence: This restaurant is good because the food is tasty and affordable.
examples.trans: 这家餐厅很好，因为食物好吃又便宜。

examples.sentence: They looked for an affordable tent before the camping trip.
examples.trans: 露营前他们找顶价格合适的帐篷。

examples.sentence: The city promised more affordable flats near the new station.
examples.trans: 市政府承诺在新车站附近提供更多可负担公寓。

examples.sentence: Affordable care is not the same as cheap care that cuts safety.
examples.trans: 可负担的护理，不等于为省钱而削减安全的廉价护理。

examples.sentence: An affordable ticket still costs too much if the venue is hours away.
examples.trans: 如果场馆要走好几小时，便宜票也可能太贵。

examples.sentence: Until wages move, calling a district affordable is mostly a slogan.
examples.trans: 工资不动之前，把一个街区称为可负担，多半只是口号。

have fun with.usageZh: 动词短语，'have fun' 是固定搭配，'with' 是介词，后接名词或动名词。口语和书面语都常用，语气轻松。

examples.sentence: Have fun with the new crayons.
examples.trans: 好好用新蜡笔玩吧。

examples.sentence: The kids have fun with the cardboard boxes more than the toy.
examples.trans: 孩子们玩纸箱比玩玩具还开心。

examples.sentence: If you have fun with cooking, you will want to try more recipes.
examples.trans: 如果你享受烹饪的乐趣，你就会想尝试更多食谱。

examples.sentence: You can have fun with a tight budget if the kitchen still has spices.
examples.trans: 预算紧也可以玩得开心，只要厨房里还有香料。

examples.sentence: He had fun with the old camera once he stopped fearing wasted film.
examples.trans: 他不再害怕浪费胶卷后，玩起那台旧相机就开心了。

examples.sentence: The most effective learners are those who can have fun with the process while still pushing themselves to improve.
examples.trans: 最有效的学习者是那些既能享受过程乐趣、又能督促自己不断进步的人。

focus on.usageZh: 短语动词，后接名词、代词或动名词。可分开使用（focus sth on sth），表示把注意力、精力或资源集中在某事物上。

examples.sentence: Please focus on your homework and turn off the TV.
examples.trans: 请专心做作业，把电视关掉。

examples.sentence: Tonight we will focus on cutting the fruit safely.
examples.trans: 今晚我们专注于安全切水果。

examples.sentence: She focused on the quietest child in the noisy room.
examples.trans: 嘈杂房间里，她把注意放在最安静的孩子身上。

examples.sentence: A hospital that focuses only on speed will miss the slow infections.
examples.trans: 只关注速度的医院，会漏掉缓慢的感染。

examples.sentence: He lost focus when the radio switched to an argumentative show.
examples.trans: 收音机换成争辩节目时，他走神了。

examples.sentence: To focus on what is measurable is tempting; the rest still shapes the outcome.
examples.trans: 专注于可测量的东西很诱人；其余部分仍在塑造结果。

make mistakes.usageZh: 动词短语，'make' 是及物动词，'mistakes' 用复数形式作宾语。常与 be afraid to / be afraid of 搭配，表示对犯错的恐惧。

examples.sentence: It is okay to make mistakes when you learn to ride a bike.
examples.trans: 学骑自行车时犯错误没关系。

examples.sentence: My teacher says we should not laugh when others make mistakes.
examples.trans: 我的老师说，别人犯错时我们不应该笑。

examples.sentence: She makes fewer mistakes now that she reads the label twice.
examples.trans: 她现在少犯错了，因为标签会读两遍。

examples.sentence: Teams that hide mistakes only postpone the larger one.
examples.trans: 隐瞒错误的团队，只是把更大的错误往后推。

examples.sentence: He made a mistake in the address, so the parcel travelled an extra day.
examples.trans: 他写错地址，包裹多走了一天。

examples.sentence: The useful question is not whether we make mistakes, but how quickly we name them.
examples.trans: 有用的问题不是我们会不会犯错，而是我们多快把错误说出来。

work towards.usageZh: 动词短语，'work' 是不及物动词，'towards' 是介词，后接名词或动名词作宾语。常用于表示长期目标或渐进努力，语体偏正式，可用于书面和口语。

examples.sentence: We work towards a cleaner playground every Friday.
examples.trans: 我们每周五都为更干净的操场努力。

examples.sentence: She is working towards a swimming badge this term.
examples.trans: 这学期她在为游泳徽章努力。

examples.sentence: The village worked towards a shared well for three summers.
examples.trans: 村子为共用的水井努力了三个夏天。

examples.sentence: They are working towards an agreement that both farms can sign.
examples.trans: 他们在努力达成两家农场都能签字的协议。

examples.sentence: Working towards quieter streets meant fewer night deliveries, not more slogans.
examples.trans: 要让街道更安静，意味着减少夜间送货，而不是多喊口号。

examples.sentence: To work towards justice is to accept that some wins will look incomplete.
examples.trans: 为正义努力，就要接受有些胜利看起来并不完整。

talk to yourself.usageZh: 动词短语，'talk' 是不及物动词，'to yourself' 是介词短语作状语。多用于描述独处时的行为，口语和书面语均可使用，常带有自我调节或练习的意味。

examples.sentence: My little brother likes to talk to himself when he plays.
examples.trans: 我弟弟玩的时候喜欢自言自语。

examples.sentence: She talks to herself in English while washing dishes.
examples.trans: 她洗碗时用英语自言自语。

examples.sentence: Talking to yourself on a bike ride can help you plan the next turn.
examples.trans: 骑车时自言自语，能帮你想好下一个弯。

examples.sentence: He talks to himself not from loneliness but to hear the sentence before he sends it.
examples.trans: 他自言自语不是因为孤独，而是想在发出句子前先听见它。

examples.sentence: Late at night she talked to herself in a whisper so the baby would not wake.
examples.trans: 深夜她低声自言自语，免得吵醒宝宝。

examples.sentence: To talk to yourself in a new language is to build a listener who will not laugh too soon.
examples.trans: 用新语言自言自语，是给自己造一个不会太早笑的听众。

build up.usageZh: 短语动词，可分开使用（build up sth / build sth up），后接名词作宾语。表示逐步积累或增强，常用于描述信心、词汇量、体力等的增长，口语和书面语均常见。

examples.sentence: Running every morning helps me build up my strength.
examples.trans: 每天早晨跑步帮助我增强体力。

examples.sentence: You can build up your vocabulary by reading storybooks regularly.
examples.trans: 你可以通过定期阅读故事书来积累词汇量。

examples.sentence: It takes time to build up trust, but only a moment to break it.
examples.trans: 建立信任需要时间，但破坏信任只需一瞬间。

examples.sentence: Dust will build up behind the fridge if nobody moves it.
examples.trans: 没人挪冰箱的话，灰会在后面积起来。

examples.sentence: The coach emphasized that consistency, not intensity, is what truly builds up long-term endurance.
examples.trans: 教练强调，真正建立长期耐力的是持续性，而不是强度。

examples.sentence: A build-up of small delays can look like bad luck until you draw the timeline.
examples.trans: 许多小延误积在一起，看起来像倒霉，直到你画出时间线。

learn a new language.usageZh: 动词短语，'learn' 是及物动词，后接名词短语。常用于谈论学习外语的过程、方法或感受。口语和书面语均可使用，常与 'start', 'try', 'want', 'decide' 等动词搭配。

examples.sentence: Lily wants to learn a new language this summer.
examples.trans: 莉莉今年夏天想学一门新语言。

examples.sentence: He began to learn a new language so he could write to his cousin.
examples.trans: 他开始学一门新语言，好写信给表哥。

examples.sentence: After moving, she had to learn a new language for the corner shop.
examples.trans: 搬家后，她得为了街角小店再学一门语言。

examples.sentence: People who learn a new language late still reshape how they hear rhythm.
examples.trans: 很晚才学新语言的人，仍会改变自己听节奏的方式。

examples.sentence: To learn a new language in a noisy household is to steal quiet minutes.
examples.trans: 在吵闹的家里学新语言，就是偷安静的几分钟。

examples.sentence: Learning a new language is less a hobby than a long negotiation with habit.
examples.trans: 学一门新语言与其说是爱好，不如说是和习惯的漫长谈判。

stay keen on.usageZh: 动词短语，'stay' 是系动词，'keen on' 是形容词短语作表语，后接名词或动名词。表示持续保持对某事物的浓厚兴趣或热情。英式英语中更常见，口语和书面语均可。

examples.sentence: Stay keen on drawing and your lines will grow steady.
examples.trans: 对画画保持热情，线条就会稳下来。

examples.sentence: Even in winter, my grandpa stays keen on getting up early for a walk.
examples.trans: 即使在冬天，我爷爷也一直热衷于早起散步。

examples.sentence: If you stay keen on the story, the hard words will start to make sense.
examples.trans: 只要你还对故事有热情，难词就会开始说得通。

examples.sentence: Few teams stay keen on a project once the applause has moved on.
examples.trans: 掌声移走之后，很少有团队还对项目保持热情。

examples.sentence: He stayed keen on night photography though the river path was cold.
examples.trans: 尽管河边小路很冷，他仍热衷夜间摄影。

examples.sentence: To stay keen on a craft after the first prizes is the quieter test.
examples.trans: 得过最初的奖之后仍热衷一门手艺，才是更安静的考验。

stick to it.usageZh: 动词短语，'stick to' 是短语动词，'it' 是代词作宾语。表示在困难面前坚持做某事，不放弃。常指坚持计划、决定、习惯或任务。口语中常用，带有鼓励或强调的语气。

examples.sentence: Learning the piano is hard, but I will stick to it.
examples.trans: 学钢琴很难，但我会坚持下去。

examples.sentence: My coach told me to make a training plan and stick to it.
examples.trans: 我的教练让我制定一个训练计划并坚持下去。

examples.sentence: Stick to it for two more weeks and the habit will feel lighter.
examples.trans: 再坚持两周，这个习惯就会轻一些。

examples.sentence: The key to mastering any skill is not talent but the willingness to stick to it through plateaus.
examples.trans: 掌握任何技能的关键不是天赋，而是在平台期仍然愿意坚持下去。

examples.sentence: Anyone can start a notebook; sticking to it through February is rarer.
examples.trans: 谁都能开始记笔记；能坚持过二月的更少。

examples.sentence: To stick to it while results stay invisible requires a reason that is not applause.
examples.trans: 结果仍看不见时还坚持下去，需要一个不是掌声的理由。

The more..., the more....usageZh: 固定句型，表示两个变化按比例同时递增。结构为“The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...”。前句是条件，后句是结果。可用于口语和书面语，语体中性偏正式。

examples.sentence: The more you stir, the thicker the soup becomes.
examples.trans: 你搅得越多，汤就越稠。

examples.sentence: The more you read, the more words you will remember.
examples.trans: 你读得越多，记住的单词就越多。

examples.sentence: The more she practised the kick, the cleaner it looked.
examples.trans: 她练踢得越多，动作看起来越干净。

examples.sentence: The more data you dump on a tired team, the less they can use.
examples.trans: 你往疲惫团队上堆的数据越多，他们能用的就越少。

examples.sentence: The more carefully he labelled the shelves, the faster the night shift found parts.
examples.trans: 他给架子贴标签越仔细，夜班找到零件就越快。

examples.sentence: The more a city treats shade as decoration, the more its summers punish people on foot.
examples.trans: 一座城市越把树荫当装饰，夏天就越惩罚走路的人。

mother tongue.usageZh: 名词短语，指一个人从小自然习得的第一语言。通常用作主语或宾语，可与动词 speak、learn、preserve 等搭配。语体中性，正式和非正式场合均可用。

examples.sentence: My mother tongue is the language I dreamed in as a child.
examples.trans: 我的母语是我小时候做梦用的语言。

examples.sentence: He writes poems in his mother tongue and emails in English.
examples.trans: 他用母语写诗，用英语写邮件。

examples.sentence: Children can keep two mother tongues if both are used at dinner.
examples.trans: 如果餐桌上两种语言都用，孩子可以保住两种母语。

examples.sentence: Losing a mother tongue is often quieter than losing a house.
examples.trans: 失去母语，往往比失去房子更安静。

examples.sentence: The radio still broadcasts weather in the village's mother tongue at dawn.
examples.trans: 电台仍在黎明用村里的母语播报天气。

examples.sentence: A mother tongue can hold jokes that no later language quite inherits.
examples.trans: 母语能装下后来的语言继承不全的笑话。

It goes without saying.usageZh: 固定表达，意为“不言而喻，理所当然”。通常放在句首，后接 that 从句。语体偏正式，常用于议论文或演讲中引出公认的事实或观点。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that we lock the door at night.
examples.trans: 夜里要锁门，这不言而喻。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that wet wood will not light easily.
examples.trans: 湿木头不容易点着，这不用说。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that a tired driver should not start a long trip.
examples.trans: 疲惫的司机不该开长途，这是明摆着的。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that unpaid internships exclude those who must earn.
examples.trans: 无薪实习把必须挣钱的人排除在外，这不必多说。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that the lab stays sealed until the alarm is green.
examples.trans: 警报变绿之前实验室保持封闭，这理所当然。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that a treaty without inspectors is mostly paper.
examples.trans: 没有核查员的条约多半是纸，这无需强调。

get your meaning.usageZh: 动词短语，'get' 在这里表示“理解”，相当于 understand。后面接名词短语作宾语，常见搭配有 get sb's meaning / get the meaning of sth。口语和书面语都可用，语气比 understand 更随意自然。

examples.sentence: Speak slowly so I can get your meaning.
examples.trans: 说慢一点，好让我明白你的意思。

examples.sentence: He used a hard word, so I didn't get his meaning at first.
examples.trans: 他用了一个难词，所以一开始我没听懂他的意思。

examples.sentence: If you speak too fast, the listeners may not get your meaning clearly.
examples.trans: 如果你说得太快，听众可能无法清楚地理解你的意思。

examples.sentence: Listeners get your meaning faster when you start with the point, not the history.
examples.trans: 先说重点而不是历史，听的人更快明白你的意思。

examples.sentence: The translator paused, then found a word that let the room get his meaning.
examples.trans: 译者停了一下，然后找到一个让全场明白他意思的词。

examples.sentence: If people only get your meaning when you shout, the problem may be the channel, not the idea.
examples.trans: 如果只有你喊他们才明白，问题可能在通道，不在想法。

communicate with.usageZh: 动词短语，后接表示人或群体的宾语，意为“与……交流”。常见搭配有 communicate with sb about sth。既可用于面对面交流，也可指通过书信、网络等方式沟通。

examples.sentence: I often communicate with my grandparents by phone.
examples.trans: 我经常通过电话和爷爷奶奶交流。

examples.sentence: The sailors communicate with lights when the radio fails.
examples.trans: 无线电失灵时，水手用灯光联络。

examples.sentence: She finds it easier to communicate with children than with cameras.
examples.trans: 她觉得和孩子交流比对着镜头容易。

examples.sentence: Offices that communicate with silence still send a message.
examples.trans: 用沉默交流的办公室，仍然在发信息。

examples.sentence: The ranger communicated with the lost hikers by whistle until dawn.
examples.trans: 护林员用口哨和迷路的徒步者联络到天亮。

examples.sentence: To communicate with another field you must risk sounding naive for a week.
examples.trans: 要与另一领域交流，你得冒险有一周听起来很天真。

not only... but also....usageZh: 并列连词，连接两个对等的语法成分，如名词、动词、形容词或句子。强调两者都成立或都重要。连接主语时，谓语动词与靠近的主语保持一致。

examples.sentence: She not only sings but also plays the drums.
examples.trans: 她不仅唱歌，还打鼓。

examples.sentence: My brother can not only swim but also play basketball well.
examples.trans: 我哥哥不仅会游泳，篮球也打得很好。

examples.sentence: He not only repaired the bike but also taught me the trick.
examples.trans: 他不仅修了车，还把窍门教给了我。

examples.sentence: The flood damaged not only shops but also the records in the basement.
examples.trans: 洪水不仅冲了店铺，还毁了地下室的档案。

examples.sentence: Not only did the lab publish the data, but it also posted the raw files.
examples.trans: 实验室不仅发表了数据，还公布了原始文件。

examples.sentence: A good public space serves not only leisure but also the unplanned conversations that hold a street together.
examples.trans: 好的公共空间不仅服务休闲，还服务把一条街黏在一起的那些不期而遇的谈话。

face to face.usageZh: 副词短语，表示“面对面地”，常与 talk、meet、sit、discuss 等动词连用，强调双方在同一空间直接交流。可用于口语和书面语，位置灵活，常放在动词后或句末。

examples.sentence: I talked to the teacher face to face after school.
examples.trans: 放学后我和老师当面谈了。

examples.sentence: We finally met face to face after three years of writing emails.
examples.trans: 在写了三年电子邮件之后，我们终于面对面见面了。

examples.sentence: A face-to-face apology landed better than a long message.
examples.trans: 当面道歉比一长段消息更到位。

examples.sentence: Some deals still require sitting face to face across a scratched table.
examples.trans: 有些交易仍需要隔着一张有刮痕的桌子面对面坐着。

examples.sentence: She preferred to explain the bill face to face so nothing hid in small print.
examples.trans: 她宁愿当面解释账单，免得小字里藏东西。

examples.sentence: Face-to-face work does not guarantee honesty; it only removes one kind of delay.
examples.trans: 面对面并不能保证诚实，只是去掉一种拖延。

afford that.usageZh: 动词短语，afford 后接名词或不定式，表示“有足够的钱或时间做某事”。常用于否定句和疑问句，常与 can、could、be able to 连用。

examples.sentence: A taxi would be nice, but we cannot afford that tonight.
examples.trans: 打车是好，但今晚我们负担不起。

examples.sentence: Private lessons help, if a family can afford that.
examples.trans: 如果家里负担得起，私教课是有帮助的。

examples.sentence: A second fridge would save trips, yet they could not afford that bill.
examples.trans: 第二台冰箱能少跑腿，可那笔账单他们付不起。

examples.sentence: The city wants night buses; the question is whether it can afford that every winter.
examples.trans: 城市想要夜班车；问题是每个冬天是否都负担得起。

examples.sentence: She could afford that risk once, but not twice in the same season.
examples.trans: 那种风险她能承担一次，但不能在同一季承担两次。

examples.sentence: When a society cannot afford that kind of care, it still pays, only later and in harsher rooms.
examples.trans: 一个社会若负担不起那种照料，它仍会付钱，只是更晚、在更苛刻的房间里。

through the Internet.usageZh: 介词短语，表示“通过互联网”这一方式或媒介，常与 buy、learn、communicate、find 等动词搭配，一般置于句末或动词后。

examples.sentence: I watch English cartoons through the Internet every weekend.
examples.trans: 我每个周末通过互联网看英语动画片。

examples.sentence: We ordered the spare part through the Internet and it arrived Friday.
examples.trans: 我们通过互联网订了零件，周五就到了。

examples.sentence: She found old maps through the Internet instead of travelling to the archive.
examples.trans: 她通过互联网找到旧地图，而不必跑去档案馆。

examples.sentence: Rumours move through the Internet faster than corrections can lace their shoes.
examples.trans: 谣言在网上走得比更正系鞋带还快。

examples.sentence: The clinic booked follow-up visits through the Internet to spare a long queue.
examples.trans: 诊所通过互联网预约复诊，免得排长队。

examples.sentence: Knowledge that travels only through the Internet still depends on who owns the cable.
examples.trans: 只通过互联网旅行的知识，仍取决于谁拥有那根缆线。

distance education.usageZh: 名词短语，不可数。常作主语或宾语，可与动词 offer、provide、receive、complete 搭配。语体偏正式，常见于教育、科技类文章。

examples.sentence: Distance education helped her study while living on the farm.
examples.trans: 远程教育让她住在农场也能学习。

examples.sentence: The college offered distance education for nurses on night shifts.
examples.trans: 学院为上夜班的护士提供远程教育。

examples.sentence: Distance education is not easier; it only moves the classroom into a smaller room.
examples.trans: 远程教育并不更容易，只是把教室搬进更小的房间。

examples.sentence: Good distance education still needs a person who answers on Thursdays.
examples.trans: 好的远程教育仍然需要一个周四会回复的人。

examples.sentence: During the storms, distance education kept the timetable from collapsing.
examples.trans: 暴风雨期间，远程教育让课表没有垮掉。

examples.sentence: Distance education widens access and, if badly funded, also widens the gap.
examples.trans: 远程教育扩大了入口；若经费不足，也会扩大差距。

stand still.usageZh: 动词短语，不及物。字面义为“站着不动”，引申义为“停滞不前”。常用于否定句或与 never、refuse to 等连用，表示持续发展或变化。

examples.sentence: Please stand still while I take the photo.
examples.trans: 我拍照时请站着别动。

examples.sentence: The queue stood still for ten minutes in the rain.
examples.trans: 队伍在雨里停了十分钟。

examples.sentence: If nobody asks a new question, the project will stand still.
examples.trans: 如果没人问新问题，项目就会停住。

examples.sentence: Wages cannot stand still while rents climb every spring.
examples.trans: 租金每年春天都在涨，工资不能原地不动。

examples.sentence: The investigation stood still until the missing notebook returned.
examples.trans: 丢失的笔记本回来之前，调查一直停着。

examples.sentence: History does not stand still; we only stop looking, then call the pause peace.
examples.trans: 历史不会停住；我们只是不再看，然后把停顿称作和平。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'would' for Polite Assumption / 情态动词'would'表示礼貌推测
grammar.title: 情态动词 would：委婉推测、礼貌看法，兼辨 will / must / might / would have
grammar.titleEn: Would for polite assumption, plus will, must, might, and would have
grammar.usage:
核心结构：would + 动词原形，用于表达说话人对某种普遍情况、他人观点或可能结果的礼貌推测。这种用法不表示过去，也不表示强烈的个人意愿，而是把判断“假设化”，使语气更委婉、更易被接受。常与 probably、most people、you、many、some 等表示普遍性或可能性的词语搭配，例如：You would probably agree that...（你大概会同意……）。

肯定式：主语 + would + 动词原形（+ 其他）。例如：Most students would find this task challenging. 否定式：主语 + would not / wouldn't + 动词原形。例如：Some people wouldn't accept this idea. 疑问式：Would + 主语 + 动词原形（+ 其他）？例如：Would you say that learning grammar is important? 注意：疑问式在礼貌推测中不如肯定式常见，多用于征询对方对普遍看法的认同。

与近义结构对比：will 表示对未来事实的肯定预测或承诺，语气更确定；would 则把预测“后退一步”，表示假设或委婉推测。could / might 也可表示推测，但 could 侧重“可能性或能力上的可能”，might 侧重“可能性较低”；would 更侧重“在某种条件下很可能如此”或“人们通常会这样认为”。例如：It will rain tomorrow.（较确定）It would probably rain if the clouds kept gathering.（假设条件下的推测）It might rain, but I'm not sure.（可能性较低）。

初中用法 vs 高中用法：初中阶段主要接触 would like、would you please 等固定表达，以及 would 在宾语从句中表示过去将来。高中阶段则需掌握 would 表示“礼貌推测、委婉判断、假设性看法”的语用功能，尤其在议论文、说明文、演讲和书信中常见。高考书面表达中，使用 would probably、most people would agree 等结构能有效提升语气的客观性和礼貌度。

易错点：1. 不要把表示推测的 would 误认为过去式，它并不指过去时间。2. 不要在该用 would 的委婉推测语境中误用 will，否则语气会显得过于绝对。3. would 表示推测时后面必须接动词原形，不能接不定式或动名词。4. 注意 would 与 probably 的位置：would probably + 动词原形，probably 放在 would 之后、实义动词之前。
forms: 主语 + would / wouldn't + 动词原形（委婉推测或看法）
Would + 主语 + 动词原形？（礼貌询问）
would probably / possibly + 动词原形
must / might / could + 动词原形（把握度对比）
would have + 过去分词（对过去的推测或未实现结果）
If + 过去时, 主语 + would + 动词原形（第二类条件）
notes: would 后不加 to，也不加 -s：He would agree，不是 He would to agree。
表示现在推测时，must 比 would 更有把握；might 更不确定。
对过去的礼貌推测用 would have done，不是 would did。
Would you mind + doing 是请求，不是推测。
表过去习惯的 would 不能与状态动词连用：不说 would be a teacher every day。

examples.en: You would probably agree that it would be great to learn it fast.
examples.cn: 你大概会同意，能快速学会它将会很棒。

examples.en: Most people would agree that the bridge needs lights.
examples.cn: 多数人会同意这座桥需要灯。

examples.en: A tired driver would not start a mountain road at midnight.
examples.cn: 疲惫的司机会在午夜开山路吗？不会。

examples.en: Many parents would probably support the idea of starting school later.
examples.cn: 许多家长大概会支持推迟上课时间的想法。

examples.en: She would have called if the ferry had been cancelled.
examples.cn: 要是轮渡取消了，她本会打电话。

examples.en: One would have thought the contract mentioned flood risk.
examples.cn: 按理说合同里该提到洪水风险。

exercises.q: Most kids ____ probably like a shorter queue.
exercises.explain: would 后接动词原形，表示委婉推测。

exercises.q: You would probably ____ (like) this song.
句子 “She would probably come.” 是正确的。
用 would 改写：I think they like the quiet street. → They ____ the quiet street.
exercises.explain: 用 would (probably) like 表示委婉看法。

exercises.q: 改错：He would to carry the bag.
____ you like some water?
exercises.explain: Would you like... 是礼貌询问。

exercises.q: He ____ agree that the park is too dark.
exercises.explain: probably 常放在 would 之后。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语，兼辨 It is + adj. + to do 与动名词复合结构
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject vs infinitive and possessive gerund
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语的核心结构是把“动词 + -ing”当作一个名词性成分放在句首，表示一种活动、行为或抽象概念。此时整个动名词短语在句中充当主语，谓语动词一律用单数形式，例如：Learning a new language takes time.（学习一门新语言需要时间。）动名词作主语时，可以只用一个动名词，也可以带宾语、状语等构成动名词短语，如 Reading books helps you learn new words. 否定形式是在动名词前直接加 not，构成 not doing 结构，例如：Not asking for help can make things worse.（不寻求帮助会让事情变得更糟。）疑问形式一般通过主句的谓语动词变化来实现，动名词本身不参与疑问词序变化，例如：Does swimming help you relax?（游泳有助于你放松吗？）

在高中阶段，动名词作主语还需要掌握两个重要拓展。第一是 it 作形式主语的用法。当动名词短语较长或需要突出表语时，常用 It is no use / no good / worthwhile / a waste of time 等结构，把真正的主语动名词短语后置，例如：It is no use crying over spilt milk.（覆水难收。）这种结构在书面语和高考语法填空中非常常见，需要能识别 it 只是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的动名词短语。第二是动名词的逻辑主语。当需要说明“谁做这个动作”时，可以在动名词前加形容词性物主代词或名词所有格，构成 one's doing 结构，例如：His coming late made the teacher angry.（他迟到让老师很生气。）在口语或非正式语体中，也常用宾格代词代替物主代词，如 Him coming late made the teacher angry.，但书面语和高考书面表达中更推荐使用物主代词形式。

动名词作主语与不定式作主语有细微区别。动名词多表示一般性、习惯性、抽象性的行为，而不定式多表示具体的、一次性的或将来的动作。例如：Swimming is fun.（游泳很有趣，指一般性活动）与 To swim in this river is dangerous.（在这条河里游泳很危险，指具体行为）。在 It is no use / no good 等固定句型中，只能用动名词，不能用不定式。

初中阶段主要要求能识别动名词作主语的基本结构，并判断谓语动词用单数；高中阶段则进一步要求掌握 it 形式主语、逻辑主语、动名词与不定式的区别，以及动名词短语作主语时主谓一致在复杂句中的运用。
forms: 动名词 + 单数谓语：Swimming is good for health.
动名词短语 + 单数谓语：Learning a foreign language takes patience.
否定形式：Not doing homework is not a good habit.
It is no use / no good / worthwhile + 动名词短语：It is no use arguing with him.
逻辑主语 + 动名词短语：His being late again surprised everyone.
动名词作主语 vs 不定式作主语：Jogging every morning keeps him fit. / To finish the work today is impossible.
notes: 动名词主语视为单数：Swimming is... 不是 are。
不定式作主语更偏具体、一次性；动名词更偏习惯、抽象。
介词后只能用动名词：before leaving，不是 before to leave。
复合结构正式语用所有格：I insist on his staying。
无生命主语也可用：Reading maps at night requires a torch。

grammar.key: First Conditional (if + present simple, future simple/imperative) / 第一类条件句 (if + 一般现在时，一般将来时/祈使句)
grammar.title: 第一类条件句：If + 现在，主句 will / be going to / 情态 / 祈使，兼 unless 与 should 倒装
grammar.titleEn: First conditional with unless, provided that, and should-inversion
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句用来谈论真实、可能发生的未来情况：如果某个条件成立，某个结果就很可能发生。它的核心结构是：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时（will 或 be going to）或祈使句。例如：If you practise every day, you will improve quickly.（如果你每天练习，你会进步很快。）

肯定式：If + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + will / be going to + 动词原形。否定式：if 从句中用 don't / doesn't / can't 等否定形式，主句用 won't / isn't going to 等。疑问式通常对主句提问：What will you do if it rains? 注意 if 从句内部仍保持一般现在时，不用 will。

主句除了 will 和 be going to 之外，还常使用情态动词 can、may、might、could 等来表示可能性、能力或建议。例如：If you finish your homework, you can watch TV.（如果你完成作业，就可以看电视。）If you ask politely, she may help you.（如果你礼貌地请求，她也许会帮你。）这类情态动词让语气更丰富，不局限于“一定会发生”。

与第二类条件句对比：第一类条件句表示真实、可能实现的未来条件；第二类条件句（if + 过去时，would + 动词原形）表示假设、不太可能或与现在事实相反的情况。例如：If it rains, we will stay at home.（第一类：真的可能下雨）If it rained now, we would stay at home.（第二类：现在并没有下雨，只是假设）

初中阶段主要掌握 if + 一般现在时，主句用 will 或 be going to，以及祈使句的基本用法。高中阶段需要进一步掌握：主句中使用情态动词 can / may / might / could 的语用差异；if 从句与 unless、as long as、provided that 等条件表达的替换；主句使用 be about to、be likely to 等更丰富的将来表达；以及在书面语中条件句的正式表达方式。

易错点一：if 从句中误用 will。这是最常见的错误，例如 If it will rain tomorrow 是错误的，应改为 If it rains tomorrow。易错点二：主句和从句时态都写成一般现在时，导致句子失去将来含义。易错点三：把祈使句主句与 if 从句的位置关系弄混，祈使句在前时通常不用逗号，if 从句在前时用逗号隔开。易错点四：混淆 be going to 和 will 的语用区别。be going to 更强调已有迹象或计划，will 更强调说话时的决定或承诺。
forms: If + 现在时, 主语 + will / be going to + 原形

Unless + 现在时, 主句（= if ... not）
If + 现在时, 情态 can/may/must/should

be going to 强调基于现状的后果。
主句可以是祈使：If the oil smokes, turn the heat down.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure 'the more..., the more...' / 比较结构 'the more..., the more...'
grammar.title: 关联比较 the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...，兼 less/fewer 与省略式
grammar.titleEn: The more..., the more... (less/fewer and elliptical forms)
grammar.usage:
“the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...”是英语中表示“越……，就越……”的核心结构，用来表达两个变化之间的正比或反比关系：前一个分句提出条件或变化，后一个分句说明随之产生的结果。该结构中的“比较级”既可以是形容词或副词的 -er 形式，也可以是 more/less + 形容词/副词。

在肯定句中，结构通常为“The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语”。例如：The more you practice, the more confident you become.（你练习得越多，就越自信。）否定形式一般在谓语部分加 not 或使用 less 构成比较级，例如：The less you worry, the better you sleep.（你担心得越少，睡得越好。）疑问形式较少直接使用，但在口语中可出现“Does the more you read mean the more you know?”这类表达，正式书面语中更常见的是将其转换为陈述句或条件句来提问。

与近义结构对比：该结构与“as...as...”不同，后者表示同等程度，而“the more..., the more...”强调程度随条件变化而递变。与“if...then...”相比，本结构不直接使用连词，而是通过两个“the + 比较级”形成固定搭配，语气更简洁有力。与“more and more + 形容词”相比，后者只描述单一事物自身程度的递增，而本结构描述两个事物之间的联动变化。

初中阶段主要要求掌握“The more..., the more...”的基本语序和常见形容词/副词的比较级形式，句子通常用一般现在时表达普遍规律。高中阶段则进一步拓展到：使用 less 表示反向关系、使用不同主语和时态、在前后分句中使用不同性质的比较级（如前为副词比较级，后为形容词比较级）、以及省略谓语动词的简略形式（如 The sooner, the better.）。此外，高中书面语中还常见将第一个分句中的主语和谓语省略，只保留“the + 比较级”的情况。

易错点一：两个分句都必须有比较级，不能一个用比较级一个用原级。易错点二：前后分句的顺序不能颠倒，条件在前，结果在后。易错点三：当比较级为 more + 多音节形容词时，more 不能省略，也不能与 -er 形式重复叠加。易错点四：在正式书面语中，两个分句之间通常用逗号隔开，但当前后分句都很短时，逗号可以省略（如 The more the merrier.）。
forms: The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语

必须用比较级，不能用最高级。
the fewer 只接可数复数；the less 接不可数或形容词。
语序固定，一般不把两句对调成非 the 结构还叫同一句型。
时态多为现在或 will，也可过去：The more I thought, the angrier I became.

grammar.key: 'As long as' for Condition / 'As long as' 表示条件
grammar.title: as long as / so long as 表条件，兼辨 unless、provided that、as soon as、as far as
grammar.titleEn: As long as versus unless, provided that, as soon as, as far as
grammar.usage:
as long as 是一个从属连词，用于引导条件状语从句，表示“只要……就……”。它引出的是一种“必要条件”，强调只要满足这个条件，主句所描述的情况就会成立或持续。核心结构为：主句 + as long as + 条件从句，或 As long as + 条件从句 + 主句。条件从句在前时，后面通常用逗号与主句隔开。

在肯定句中，as long as 表示“只要满足某一条件即可”，语气比 if 更强调“这是唯一需要满足的条件”。在否定句中，常与主句的否定形式搭配，表示“只要不……就不……”或“只有在不……的情况下才……”。疑问句中，as long as 引导的条件从句通常与主句的疑问形式连用，用来询问在某种条件下是否可以做某事。

与近义结构对比：if 是最通用的条件连词，语气中性；as long as 更强调条件的充分性和“唯一性”；provided that / providing that 更正式，多用于书面语或正式场合，表示“在……条件下”；as far as 表示“就……而言”，不引导条件；as soon as 表示“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，与条件无关。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 as long as 的基本含义“只要”，并能与 if 进行简单替换。高中阶段则要求进一步区分 as long as 与 provided that、as far as、as soon as 的语域和语义差异，理解其在书面语中的使用频率，并能在写作中准确运用。同时，高中阶段还需注意 as long as 引导的从句在时态上的限制，以及主从句之间的逻辑关系。

易错点一：把 as long as 与 as far as 混淆。as far as 表示“就……而言”，后面常接 I know、I'm concerned 等，不表示条件。易错点二：把 as long as 与 as soon as 混淆。as soon as 表示时间上的“一……就……”，强调动作的先后，而非条件。易错点三：在 as long as 引导的条件从句中误用将来时。条件从句中通常用一般现在时表示将来。易错点四：忽略 as long as 的“唯一条件”含义，在需要表达“如果”的普通条件时过度使用，导致语气过强。
forms: 主句 + as long as + 条件从句（一般现在时）
As long as + 条件从句（一般现在时）, + 主句
主句（否定式） + as long as + 条件从句（否定式）
主句（疑问式） + as long as + 条件从句（一般现在时）
As long as + 条件从句, + 祈使句
主句 + as long as + 条件从句（现在完成时，强调条件持续）
notes: as long as 从句通常不用 will。
不要和 as soon as（一……就）或 as far as（就……而言）混淆。
as long as 也可字面表示“长达……时间”，需靠语境区分。
只要条件成立，主句就成立，语气比 if 更强调“这一条就够了”。
否定可用 as long as you don't...。

exercises.q: You can go out ____ you finish your milk.
You can watch TV as long as you ____ (finish) homework.
as long as 从句必须用 will。

exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，后接条件从句。

exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，强调满足条件即可。

exercises.q: ______ you are happy, I don't mind what you do.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。

options: As long as you help, I am glad.
As long as you will help, I am glad.
As long you help, I am glad.
Long as you help, I glad.

exercises.explain: as far as 表范围，不是条件。

exercises.explain: 字面“长达”与条件交界，这里表持续条件。

exercises.q: You will make progress ______ you keep practicing every day.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。

exercises.q: ______ you don't tell anyone else, I will share the secret with you.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，强调唯一条件。

exercises.q: We can finish the project on time ______ everyone works together.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导必要条件。

exercises.q: You may use my computer ______ you don't delete any files.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，后接条件从句。

exercises.q: ______ the weather is good, we will go hiking this weekend.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件。

exercises.q: They may camp as long as they ____ (not light) a fire.

so long as 与 as long as 意思相近。
换成 unless：As long as you lock it, it is safe. → It is not safe ____ you lock it.
As long as you have a connection, there ____ tons of resources.
You can teach online as long as both sides ____ (agree) on time.

用 provided that 改写：As long as you bring a torch, the path is safe. → Provided that you ____ a torch, the path is safe.

exercises.answer: As long as you agree on time, we can teach.

exercises.explain: on condition that 同样用现在时。

exercises.q: So long as the radio ____, do not panic.
As soon as they ____ the hill, they called.
exercises.explain: as soon as 时间，可用过去。

exercises.q: ______ you have a clear goal and work steadily toward it, success is within reach.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。

exercises.q: The project will be approved ______ the budget does not exceed the limit.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，强调必要条件。

exercises.q: You may take a day off ______ you inform your manager in advance.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件。

exercises.q: ______ the evidence is reliable, the conclusion can be accepted.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导必要条件。

exercises.q: The plan will work ______ everyone fulfills their responsibility.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，强调条件满足即可。

辨时间：他们一到山顶就打电话。They called ____ soon as they reached the hill.
用 so long as：只要不点火，就可以露营。You may camp ____ you don't light a fire.
exercises.answer: so long as / as long as

exercises.q: You may publish as long as the raw files ____ posted.
As long as both farms ____ (sign), the agreement holds.
as long as 与 unless 一正一反，不能随便互换而不改主句极性。

exercises.answer: As long as the raw files are posted, you may publish.

exercises.q: The street remains livable as long as shade ____ as infrastructure.

exercises.q: Inspectors can wait as long as the lab ____ sealed.

exercises.q: ______ you keep trying, you will make progress in English.
exercises.explain: 句意表示“只要你坚持尝试”，as long as 引导必要条件。

exercises.q: We can have the picnic in the park ______ it doesn't rain.

exercises.q: You will be able to speak English well ______ you practise every day.

exercises.answer: so long as / as long as

exercises.q: 改错：As long as incentives will move, campaigns work.
exercises.answer: As long as incentives move, campaigns work.

exercises.q: The board will sign as long as it ____ the numbers.
So long as night deliveries continue, the street ____ sleep.
You can keep the title as long as you ____ not dress repetition as excellence.
On condition that inspectors ____ real access, the treaty lives.
You may borrow my notes ______ you don't lend them to anyone else.

exercises.q: ______ we work together, we can finish the project on time.
exercises.explain: as long as 引导条件，表示“只要我们合作”。

exercises.q: The teacher said we could choose any topic ______ it was related to the unit.

exercises.q: You can achieve your goal ______ you don't give up halfway.

exercises.q: I will support you ______ your plan is reasonable.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要计划合理”，强调条件。

exercises.q: Knowledge stays ungated as long as access ____ not sold as privilege.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure: The more... the more... / 越...越...结构
grammar.title: 叠用比较级 more and more / -er and -er / less and less，兼辨 the more..., the more...
grammar.titleEn: Double comparatives: more and more, -er and -er, less and less
grammar.usage:
“越……越……”结构用于表示两个动作、状态或程度之间存在着同步变化的关系：一个方面增强或减弱，另一个方面也随之增强或减弱。其核心结构为“The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语”，前后两个分句通常用逗号隔开。比较级可以是形容词比较级（如 harder, better, more important），也可以是副词比较级（如 more quickly, more carefully），还可以是“more + 名词”结构（如 more money, more experience）。

肯定形式中，前后两个分句都使用比较级，表示“越……就越……”。例如：The more you read, the more you understand. 否定形式通常在分句中加入否定词，如：The less you worry, the better you will feel. 疑问形式较少直接使用，但在口语或书面语中可以通过疑问句来询问这种关系，如：Is it true that the more you practice, the better you get? 需要注意的是，该结构本身不是疑问句，而是陈述一种规律或趋势。

与近义结构对比：该结构与“as + 原级 + as”不同，后者表示同级比较，如“as fast as possible”并不表示“越快越好”的递进关系。与“more and more + 原级”也不同，“more and more”只表示单方面程度的持续增加，而“the more…, the more…”强调两个方面的联动变化。高中阶段还需要掌握省略形式，如“The sooner, the better.”（越快越好），这种省略主语和谓语的形式在口语和书面语中都很常见。

初中阶段主要要求学生掌握基本结构，能够识别和完成简单的句型转换，如将“If you study harder, you will get better grades.”改写为“The harder you study, the better grades you will get.”高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能够在写作中灵活运用该结构表达复杂逻辑关系；第二，能够识别并理解省略形式；第三，能够将“the more…, the more…”结构与名词性从句、定语从句等复合结构结合使用；第四，注意前后分句的时态和语序，尤其是当分句中含有情态动词或完成时态时。

易错点一：忘记在比较级前加“the”。例如误写为“More you read, more you know.”，正确形式应为“The more you read, the more you know.”。易错点二：前后分句都使用原级而非比较级。例如误写为“The hard you work, the good you get.”，正确形式应为“The harder you work, the better you get.”。易错点三：前后分句语序混乱，把主语和谓语的位置放错。例如误写为“The more you read, the more know you.”，正确形式应为“The more you read, the more you know.”。易错点四：在省略形式中误加主语或谓语，例如把“The sooner, the better.”写成“The sooner you do it, the better it is.”，虽然后者语法上不算错，但在固定表达中应使用省略形式。
forms: The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语（如：The harder you work, the more you achieve.）
The + more + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语, the + more + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语（如：The more books you read, the more knowledge you gain.）
The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形（如：The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.）
The + 比较级, the + 比较级（省略形式，如：The more, the better. / The sooner, the better.）
The + less + 主语 + 谓语, the + less + 主语 + 谓语（表示递减关系，如：The less you complain, the less stressed you feel.）
The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分（含从句或状语，如：The more languages a person learns, the more cultures he or she can experience.）
notes: 不要写成 more and more colder。
单音节用 -er and -er：bigger and bigger。
与 the more..., the more... 不要混用两个句型的零件。
people 用 more and more people，不用 more and more person。
less and less 后接不可数或形容词，可数复数常用 fewer and fewer。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense (with 'after') / 现在完成时（与'after'连用）
grammar.title: 现在完成时与 after/once/as soon as，兼 already/yet/for/since 与完成进行
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect after time conjunctions; already, yet, for, since
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能是表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或者表示从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态。当它出现在 after 引导的时间状语从句中时，强调从句动作先于主句动作完成，并且这一完成状态与主句所描述的现在情况紧密相关。例如在“after they have gained enough knowledge”中，have gained 强调“获得知识”这一过程已经完成，为主句“stop learning”提供了时间背景和原因铺垫。

肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句将 have/has 提到主语之前。在 after 从句中，主句可以用一般现在时、一般将来时或祈使句，但从句用现在完成时来强调动作的完成性。

与一般过去时的对比：after they gained knowledge 只陈述过去发生的动作，不强调与现在的关联；而 after they have gained knowledge 则突出“已经获得”这一完成状态对现在的影响。与 before、when、as soon as、once 等引导的时间状语从句类似，after 从句中也常用现在完成时来体现“先完成、后发生”的时间顺序。

初中阶段主要要求掌握现在完成时的基本构成和“已完成”与“未完成”两种用法，常与 already、yet、just、ever、never 等副词搭配。高中阶段则进一步要求在复杂句中使用现在完成时，尤其是在时间状语从句中与一般现在时、一般将来时配合，体现动作先后关系和语篇逻辑。同时，高中还需区分现在完成时与现在完成进行时、过去完成时的语用差异。

易错点一：在 after 引导的时间状语从句中误用一般将来时。英语中时间状语从句不用将来时，要用现在完成时或一般现在时代替将来完成时。易错点二：混淆 after 从句中一般过去时和现在完成时的语用区别——前者仅叙述过去，后者强调完成与关联。易错点三：主句为一般现在时时，从句用现在完成时容易让学生困惑，需明确这是为了突出动作的完成性而非时间上的“过去”。易错点四：不规则动词的过去分词形式掌握不牢，导致结构错误。
forms: have / has + 过去分词
after / when / once / as soon as + 现在完成时, 主句
already / yet / just / ever / never
for + 时段 / since + 起点
after having + 过去分词（分词短语）
have/has been + doing（完成进行）
notes: 时间从句里用现在完成代替将来完成：After I have eaten, I will go。不用 after I will have 在口语里也常简化。
already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
短暂动词可完成但不宜接 for 一段时间：不要 He has arrived for two hours，改用 been here。
after having done 更书面。
现在完成与一般过去常成对考：有具体过去时间用过去时。

grammar.title: nor / neither 部分倒装，兼 so、否定副词与 not until / only after
grammar.titleEn: Inversion after nor, neither, never, not until, only after
grammar.usage:
核心结构：当 nor 用于引出另一个否定陈述，表示“也不……”，且该句主语与前句主语不同时，nor 后面的句子必须使用部分倒装，即把助动词、be 动词或情态动词提到主语之前。基本结构为：Nor + 助动词/be动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 其他成分。nor 本身已经含有否定意义，因此句中不再使用 not。

肯定、否定与疑问：nor 引导的倒装句本身表达否定含义，通常不单独构成一般疑问句，而是作为并列否定陈述的第二部分出现。前句可以是否定句，也可以是含有 few、little、never、hardly、seldom 等半否定或否定副词的句子。若前句为肯定句，则不能用 nor，而应用 so 引导倒装表示“也……”。

与近义结构对比：nor 与 neither 在引导倒装句时意义基本相同，都表示“也不”。区别在于：nor 更常见于连接两个分句，前句往往是否定句；neither 可单独用于句首，也可与 nor 搭配构成 neither...nor... 结构。so 则用于肯定句后的“也……”倒装，与 nor/neither 形成对称。高中阶段还需注意 nor 可用于“否定句 + nor + 倒装句”的并列结构中，且 nor 前可用逗号或分号。

初中用法 vs 高中用法：初中阶段主要要求掌握“前句否定 + nor/neither + 倒装”的基本公式，能完成句型转换和语法填空。高中阶段则进一步要求：1）识别前句中 few、little、never、hardly、seldom、rarely、by no means 等隐性否定词，并正确使用 nor 倒装；2）在书面表达中主动使用 nor 倒装增强句式多样性；3）区分 nor 倒装与 so 倒装、neither...nor... 并列结构、not...nor... 等变体；4）注意 nor 引导倒装时助动词的时态、情态动词的选择须与前句呼应。

易错点：1）前句虽无 not，但含 few、little、never 等否定意义词时，后句仍可用 nor 倒装，不能误判为肯定句而改用 so。2）nor 引导的倒装句中不能再加 not，否则造成双重否定。3）nor 倒装时助动词或 be 动词的时态要与前句保持一致，不能随意更换时态。4）前句主语与后句主语不同时才用 nor 倒装；若前后主语相同，通常用 neither 或 not...either 表达，如“He didn't go, and he didn't want to go either.”而非 nor 倒装。
forms: Nor + be动词 + 主语 + 其他成分
Nor + 助动词(do/does/did/have/has/had) + 主语 + 动词原形/过去分词 + 其他成分
Nor + 情态动词(can/could/will/would/may/might/must) + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他成分
否定句 + ; nor + 倒装句
否定句 + . Neither + 倒装句（与 nor 倒装可互换）
前句含 few/little/never/hardly/seldom 等否定词 + , nor + 倒装句
notes: nor 后不要再加 not。
助动词必须提前：Nor was there... 不是 Nor there was。
前句若是 there be 否定，后句常 nor was there。
neither 可单独倒装：I don't. Neither do I。
并列 neither A nor B 作主语时谓语就近或按习惯用单数，视语体。

exercises.q: I don't swim, nor ____ my sister.

exercises.q: He can't swim, and ______ I.
exercises.explain: 前句有情态动词 can 的否定形式，nor 后用 can 倒装，且不再重复否定。

exercises.q: They weren't tired, and ______ we.
exercises.explain: 前句为 be 动词过去式复数否定，nor 后用 were 倒装。

She doesn't run, nor Tom does.

补助动词：He isn't tired, nor ____ I.

exercises.q: We have no map, nor ____ we a compass.
exercises.explain: 实义 have 可用 do；nor have we 亦可，本题选 do。

exercises.q: She never shouts, nor ____ she slam doors.
I didn't wait. ____ did they.

He has never been to Beijing, and ______ his wife.
exercises.explain: 前句为现在完成时否定，主语 his wife 是第三人称单数，用 has 倒装。

exercises.q: They didn't finish the work, and ______ we.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 倒装。

exercises.q: She won't go to the party, and ______ I.
exercises.explain: 前句有 will 的否定形式，nor 后用 will 倒装。

exercises.explain: 主语 my uncle 是第三人称单数，前句为一般现在时否定，用 does 倒装。

exercises.explain: 主语 the teacher 是单数，前句为 be 动词过去式否定，用 was 倒装。

exercises.q: He hasn't called, nor ____ he written.
They weren't hungry, nor ____ we.
nor 后面再加 not 可以加强否定。
neither：I didn't go. She didn't go. → I didn't go, ____ she.

用 nor 连接：Few online classes existed. Easy access did not exist. → There were few online classes; ____ easy access.

Never ____ I seen the river so low.
He speaks neither French ____ Spanish.
Seldom ____ the night market close before ten.

exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 提前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She has never complained about the working conditions, nor ______ any intention of leaving.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为现在完成时，用 has 提前，后接过去分词。

exercises.q: The government didn't provide sufficient funding for the project, nor ______ any clear guidelines for its implementation.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为一般过去时否定，用 did 提前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: He couldn't solve the problem by himself, nor ______ anyone else in the team.
exercises.explain: 前句有情态动词 could 的否定形式，nor 后用 could 倒装，且不再重复否定。

exercises.q: The old system wasn't efficient, nor ______ cost-effective.
exercises.explain: nor 后需部分倒装，前句为 be 动词过去式否定，用 was 提前。

exercises.q: Hardly ____ they started when the rain returned.
exercises.explain: hardly 倒装常用过去完成。

So fragile ____ the trust that one delay undid it.
He didn't go to the party, and ______ his sister.
exercises.explain: 前句为否定句，nor 引出另一个否定陈述时需部分倒装，助动词 did 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She can't swim, and ______ her brother.
exercises.explain: nor 表示“也不”，后接情态动词 can 并倒装，且不再重复否定词。

exercises.explain: 前句含否定词 never，nor 后用 have 倒装表示“我父母也没去过”。

exercises.q: They weren't tired, and ______ we.
exercises.explain: nor 引出否定倒装句，be 动词 were 提到主语 we 之前。

exercises.q: Tom doesn't like coffee, and ______ his friend.
exercises.explain: 前句为一般现在时否定句，nor 后用 does 构成倒装。

exercises.q: Under no circumstances ____ we seal the lab without the alarm.

rarely：The draft rarely mentions inspectors. → Rarely ____ inspectors.

exercises.q: The students hadn't prepared for the exam, and ______ the teacher.

exercises.q: My brother won't attend the meeting, and ______ my sister.
exercises.explain: nor 后接 will 并倒装，表示“我妹妹也不会参加”。

exercises.q: He had never seen such a beautiful sunset, and ______ his wife.
exercises.explain: 前句含否定词 never，nor 后用 had 倒装表示“他妻子也没见过”。

exercises.q: She doesn't enjoy horror movies, and ______ her best friend.
exercises.explain: nor 引出倒装句，助动词 does 提前，表示“她最好的朋友也不喜欢”。

exercises.q: The children weren't allowed to go out alone, and ______ their cousins.
exercises.explain: nor 后 be 动词 were 倒装，表示“他们的表亲也不被允许”。

exercises.q: Nor ____ shade treated as infrastructure.

little 位于句首且表否定时要倒装。

exercises.q: Not until the next decade ____ the bill arrive.

grammar.titleEn: Unless, only if, otherwise, or else, and elliptical if not
grammar.usage:
“as long as” 是一个从属连词，用来引导条件状语从句，核心含义是“只要”，表示主句成立所依赖的充分条件。它的基本结构是：As long as + 条件从句, + 主句。条件从句可以放在主句之前，也可以放在主句之后；放在句首时，从句后通常加逗号。

在肯定句中，“as long as” 强调“只要满足这个条件，结果就会成立”。例如：As long as you keep practising, you will improve. 在否定句中，否定词可以出现在主句或从句中，但要注意语义差别：主句否定表示“只要……就不……”，从句否定表示“只要不……就……”。疑问句中，“as long as” 通常出现在主句为疑问形式的结构里，例如：Can I use the lab as long as I sign in? 此时它仍表示条件，而非时间。

“as long as” 与 “if” 都表示条件，但 “if” 更中性、更宽泛，而 “as long as” 更强调条件的充分性和说话人的主观期待，语气更强。“unless” 表示“除非”，相当于 “if...not”，与 “as long as” 形成条件正反对比。“provided that” 和 “on condition that” 更正式，多用于书面语或法律、商务语境，而 “as long as” 在口语和书面语中都常见。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 “as long as” 的基本含义“只要”，并能与 “if” 做简单替换。高中阶段则要求进一步理解它在真实语境中的语用功能，比如表达承诺、限制、警告或鼓励，同时要能区分它与 “as long as” 表时间“长达……”的用法。高中写作中，使用 “as long as” 替代单一的 “if” 可以增强逻辑性和语气。

易错点一：把 “as long as” 误认为时间状语“长达……之久”。判断方法是看前后句之间是否存在“条件—结果”关系。易错点二：在条件从句中使用一般将来时。英语中，条件状语从句通常用一般现在时表示将来，即使主句是 will 结构。易错点三：混淆 “as long as” 与 “as far as”。“as far as” 表示“就……而言”，不引导条件。易错点四：在正式书面语中过度使用 “as long as”，忽略 “provided that” 等更正式的替换表达。
forms: As long as + 主语 + 一般现在时, + 主句（一般现在时/一般将来时/祈使句）
主句 + as long as + 主语 + 一般现在时
As long as + 主语 + 一般现在时（否定式）, + 主句
主句（否定式） + as long as + 主语 + 一般现在时
As long as + 从句, + 主句 = Provided that + 从句, + 主句（更正式）
As long as + 从句, + 主句 ≠ As long as + 时间段（表“长达……”）
notes: unless 已含否定，通常不再加 don't。
as long as 是正面充分条件，unless 是例外门槛。
only if 比 if 更窄：只有在该条件下才发生。
otherwise 是副词，不是连词带从句：Leave now; otherwise you will miss it。
虚拟 If I were you 不能简单换成 unless I were you 而不改意思。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: not only... but also... 平行结构与句首倒装，呼应动名词主语长句
grammar.titleEn: Not only... but also... with parallelism and inversion
grammar.usage: 动名词是动词的 -ing 形式，在句中起名词作用，可以充当主语。其核心结构为“动名词短语 + 单数谓语 + 其他成分”，例如：Knowing a language helps you express yourself. 动名词作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数，因为整个动名词短语被视作一个抽象的单数概念。肯定句直接以动名词短语开头；否定句在动名词前加 not，如 Not asking for help is sometimes a mistake. 疑问句可借助 it 作形式主语构成，如 Is learning grammar important?，也可用 wh-疑问词引导，如 What causes stress? — Waiting too long. 动名词作主语通常表示一般性、习惯性或抽象的动作，强调行为本身；而不定式作主语往往表示具体的、一次性的或将来的动作，且常与特定条件或目的相关。初中阶段主要要求识别“动名词开头 + 单数谓语”的句型，并能正确判断主谓一致；高中阶段则进一步要求区分动名词与不定式作主语的语用差异，掌握 it 作形式主语的正式表达，理解动名词短语作主语在书面语、议论文和谚语中的高频使用，并能将动词短语名词化以提升表达的抽象性和正式度。易错点包括：把动名词误认为进行时谓语；谓语忘记用单数；在需要表达具体、一次性动作时误用动名词；以及动名词短语较长时不会用 it 作形式主语进行句式调整。
forms: 动名词短语 + 单数谓语 + 宾语/表语：Learning a foreign language takes time.
否定：Not + 动名词短语 + 单数谓语：Not asking for help can make things worse.
It + 单数谓语 + 动名词短语（形式主语结构）：It is no use crying over spilt milk.
动名词短语 + is + 形容词/名词（表评价）：Reading widely is essential for writing well.
There is no + 动名词短语（固定句型）：There is no denying the importance of practice.
动名词作主语 vs 不定式作主语：Swimming is good exercise.（泛指） / To swim in this river is dangerous today.（具体）
notes: 前后语法形式要平行：都是名词、或都是动词、或都是从句。
句首 Not only 倒装的是前半，but also 后不倒装。
连接主语时谓语常与最近主语一致。
不要写成 not only... and also 或 but also... too 叠床架屋。
as well as 重心在前面一项，谓语跟前面主语。
